body.statement: For every \(\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\), \(|V(\mathcal C;\widehat\Sigma)-V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)|\le 2^{K+1}N_{\exp}^{-1}\|\widehat\Sigma-\Sigma\|_{1,\mathrm{ord}}\). Therefore \(0\le V(\widehat{\mathcal C};\Sigma)-V(\mathcal C^\star;\Sigma)\le 2^{K+2}N_{\exp}^{-1}\|\widehat\Sigma-\Sigma\|_{1,\mathrm{ord}}\).
body.justification: The deterministic envelope translates pilot covariance accuracy into true-criterion design regret without margin or optimizer-uniqueness assumptions.
body.gap: Viviano proves pilot-regret for a different network-design objective; Zhu et al.'s iterative covariance design has no displayed ordered-entry perturbation guarantee.
body.consumer: A pilot study can report a numerical upper bound on the loss from deploying its plug-in exact partition.
